name: ProSeller AI – Product Content Creator and Optimizer for WooCommerce (No API Required)
author: storepro

sections.description:
💡 What is ProSeller AI?

ProSeller AI is the fastest and easiest way to generate SEO-optimized product content for your WooCommerce store. With AI-powered technology, you can create product titles, descriptions, and short descriptions instantly— no API key required.

🚀 How It Works

Simply install the plugin, and you’ll get 500 free credits each month to start generating content. No setup, no extra costs—just smarter content creation for your store.

✅ Why Choose ProSeller AI?

  • 🎁 500 Free Credits Every Month – No strings attached. Start creating content without needing your own API key.
  • ⚡ Instant AI-Powered Content – Generate product titles, descriptions, short descriptions, and variation content instantly with AI.
  • 🎯 SEO-Optimized Content – Content is crafted with SEO in mind to increase visibility and boost sales.
  • ✍️ Rewrite & Optimize Existing Content – Easily improve your current product descriptions using AI-powered suggestions.
  • 🛒 Bulk Product Generation – Create or improve 1000’s of product descriptions, short descriptions, and titles in a single operation.
  • 🧠 Audience Control – Tailor your content to specific audiences, styles, and tones that resonate with your target market.
  • 🔐 No API Key Required – 500 free monthly credits allow you to generate content without the need for an external API key. Option to use your OpenAI API key in the PRO version.

📦 Key Benefits

  • ✅ Fast and simple content creation for WooCommerce products.
  • ✅ Improve existing descriptions easily and consistently.
  • ✅ Generate missing content such as short descriptions.
  • ✅ Create multiple versions of your content to experiment with better descriptions.
  • ✅ Optimize for SEO by adjusting content to target specific search terms.
  • ✅ Control formatting with options like bullet points or paragraphs for product presentation.

🚀 Pro Version Available

Unlock additional features with the Pro version:
– 🚀 Use Your Own API Key – If you have an existing OpenAI API key, use it for your content generation.
– 🚀 Increased Credit Plans – Get up to 10,000 credits with Pro subscriptions.
– 🚀 Direct Influence on Features – Pro users help decide which features we develop next and get early access.

🚧 Coming Soon

  • SEO Meta Description Generation – Create SEO meta descriptions instantly.
  • A/B Testing for Descriptions – Test multiple versions of a product description to find the highest-converting content.
  • A/B Image Testing – Test various product images to find the highest-converting option.
  • Profitability Optimizer – Get pricing suggestions and A/B test pricing to maximize profits.
  • Competitor Tracking – Track competitor prices to stay competitive.
  • Tag Generation – Automatically generate product tags for better search optimization.
  • Related Products – Automatically link related products to boost customer engagement.
  • Auto Audience Targeting – Automatically tune product descriptions based on audience insights.
  • Support for Multiple AI Models – Use AI models from different providers beyond OpenAI.
  • Targeted Descriptions by Region – Customize content for different geographical markets.

✅ Features at a Glance

  • ✅ 500 free monthly AI credits
  • ✍️ Generate product titles, descriptions, and short descriptions
  • 🛒 Built specifically for WooCommerce
  • ⚡ Bulk content generation
  • 🧠 Rewrite existing content
  • 🎯 Customize tone, audience, and style
  • 🔐 No API key required (optional with PRO)

🔒 Disclaimer

ProSeller AI is a conversion optimization plugin that helps you connect to AI services without needing to have your own API Key. All plugin data is stored securely on your WordPress server. Content is generated by Open AI, we do not store any of your content. Always follow your local regulations and consult legal professionals if needed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ai-product-content-creator-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings under ‘ProSeller AI’ in the admin dashboard.
sections.faq:
How do I use the plugin?

You can generate product content by navigating to the product edit page.

Where can I get support?

Support is available through the plugin support page.

Is the plugin free?

Yes, the plugin is free to use with 500 monthly credits that automatically renew each month. If you need additional credits, you can upgrade to the PRO version for more flexibility and features.

Do I need an API Key?

No, you don’t need an API key to use the plugin. However, if you upgrade to the PRO version, you have the option to use your own OpenAI API key if needed.

Does the Plugin only work on WooCommerce Products?

Yes, the plugin is designed specifically for WooCommerce products.
sections.changelog:
1.6.0

  • Free credit limit increased to 500

1.5.4

  • Introduced free credits for content generation, allowing users to generate content without an API key in the free version.
  • Removed the manual API key configuration for free users.
  • Enhanced the settings page with dedicated options for Free and PRO users.

1.5.3

  • Bug Fix

1.5.2

  • Optimized prompt structure.
  • Optimized customization options.

1.5.1

  • Bug Fix

1.5

  • Introduced new customization options for content generation, allowing users to tailor the tone, style, and audience of the product descriptions.
  • Added the ability to select different description formats, such as bullet points, paragraphs, or paragraphs with bullet points, to better suit your product presentation needs.

1.4

  • Plugin Renamed into ProSeller AI – AI Product Content Creator and Optimizer for WooCommerce.

1.3

  • Added batch processing for product content generation to avoid server overload.
  • Added error display for Cloudflare 504 timeout errors.
  • Improved handling of AJAX requests with retry mechanism and exponential backoff.

1.2.1

  • Display API errors on frontend during bulk content generation.
  • Removed hiding of the prompt field from the “content to generate” field, allowing regeneration of the same field content using previous content as a prompt.
  • Added console log and debug log enable/disable options in settings.

1.2.0

  • Introduced Bulk Content Creation on the WooCommerce product listing page.
  • Select multiple products and click “Generate Contents Using AI” to create content.
  • Choose specific fields as prompts and define which fields to generate (title, description, short description).
  • Automatically saves the generated content for the selected products.
  • Enhanced content generation for higher efficiency in product content creation.

1.1.0

  • Fixed issues with adding new products.
  • Added feature to generate new title, description, and short description from existing content.
  • Rewrote existing product variation’s description.
  • Tested with WordPress 6.7 and WooCommerce 9.4.1.
  • Verified compatibility with PHP 8.3.11.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
